mapper.insert: INSERT INTO otp_codes (user_id, code, expires_at, attempt_count, is_used) VALUES (#{userId}, #{code}, #{expiresAt}, 0, false)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, code, expires_at, attempt_count, is_used, created_at FROM otp_codes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_used = false ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE otp_codes SET is_used = true WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE otp_codes SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
